senses.gloss: f. (v. חוֹצֶלֶת) matting used for partition, covering &c., in gen. mat.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 1:11">Succ. I, 11</cite> <he>מ׳ קנים</he> a reed mat.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 1:10">Tosef. ib. I, 10</cite> <he>מ׳ של שיחופא</he>; <cite ref="Sukkah 20a:11">Succ. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ של שיפה</he> a mat of bulrushes.

<cite ref="Beitzah 36a:14">Bets. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>פורסין מ׳ ע״ג וכ׳</he> you may spread a mat over bricks &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַחֲצָלוֹת</he>. Succ. l. c. (expl. <he>חוצלות</he>) <he>מ׳ ממש</he> real mats. Y. ib. II, end, 52ᶜ <he>מַחְצְלוֹת אושא</he> mattings of Usha.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:3:2">Y. Erub. VII, 24ᶜ</cite> top <he>מַחְצְלָיוֹת</he> (not <he>ליית …</he>).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21">Num. R. s. 21</cite> <he>מַחְצְלָאוֹת</he>; a. fr.
